theme_toggle: Switch between light and dark theme
noscript: This atlas needs JavaScript to display the records.
load_error: The embedded atlas data could not be read.
integrity_disclosure: Published view: {full} entries in full, {summary} as summaries, {hidden} hidden. A hidden entry is still part of the hash chain, so nothing was dropped.
integrity_ledger_ok: Ledger verified: {count} entries, head seq {seq}, hash {hash}
integrity_ledger_failed: LEDGER FAILED VERIFICATION ({count} problems). Do not rely on the data below.
integrity_cards: {count} evidence cards read from files. They are shown as found and are not verified against a ledger.
integrity_issues: {count} files were skipped (malformed or not an evidence card)
truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} records (row limit).
chart_timeline_desc: Bar chart of records per month, first month {first}, last month {last}, highest count {max}
search_placeholder: Search id, protocol, domain, status, claim boundary, sources
no_results: No records match the current filters.
shortcuts: Keyboard: / search, j and k move, Enter opens, Esc closes.
clipped_note: Very long values are clipped here; the source file is authoritative.
footer_honest: Counts are shown exactly as recorded in the source. Nothing is hidden or reclassified, and unknown statuses are displayed as found.
detail_unavailable: The other fields could not be decoded in this browser; the source file has them.
